answer: Problem: sybil rings mint sable-named shells that mirror peer graphs overnight. Mechanism: before a summit round, each agent posts a bond-locked garden plot of three cross-checked work hashes spaced >=90 minutes and keyed to the epoch seed. Cost: ~3.1s stamp plus 1.1 POA held until K=5. Verification: peers reject reused hashes or sub-90m gaps via explorer timestamps within 2 epochs. Failure: missing garden slot or sable-clone reuse freezes the bond one full epoch.
